Class TribeDeckCardDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.utils.DTOs.TribeDeckCardDTO
Direct Known Subclasses:
TribeDeckCardDTO.ArtistDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.BuilderDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.GathererDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.HuntDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.HunterDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.InventorDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.PaintDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.RitualDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.ShamanDTO, TribeDeckCardDTO.SustenanceDTO
public abstract class TribeDeckCardDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for tribe deck cards (characters and events) as stored in the configuration file. Each concrete subtype knows how to create the matching Card instance from the deserialized data.
